projectSummary: A third press-versus-fly activation dataset, at a submaximal matched relative load. Carried for the contradiction map alongside the other two.

publication.statusSource: Crossref REST API works record plus the Crossref/Retraction Watch CSV export, both fetched 2026-09-13

notes: Abstract-only; the per-exercise pectoralis values are not in the retrievable abstract.
Participants were screened for scapular dyskinesis, which is a movement-pattern finding rather than a diagnosed pathology; all were asymptomatic.

study.population: Twenty-eight physically active men were allocated to a control group (n = 14) and a scapular dyskinesis group (n = 14), all asymptomatic. They performed six repetitions of three seconds of the bench press and the dumbbell fly at 50 per cent of 1RM, on a bench and on a Swiss ball.

title: Activation of upper limb muscles in subjects with scapular dyskinesis during bench-press and dumbbell fly on stable and unstable surfaces.
